long_biography.plain_text:
Aslanoba entered the family water company after studying business in Istanbul and finance in the United States. As chief executive, he modernised production and distribution while helping Erikli advance from a small regional operation to leadership of Turkey's bottled-water market.

After forming a majority partnership with Nestlé Waters, he stayed as local partner and chief executive before leaving the business in 2012. He then learned the startup market, assembled a broad technology portfolio and established a dedicated investment firm, applying consumer-brand and logistics experience to young digital companies and founders.
